clubs.name: SC Cambuur
clubs.note: WRONG GROUND, CORRECTED, 2026-10-01, in the Netherlands pass - the Brentford shape. Wikidata's only P115 on Q875120 is Q1028392, the old Cambuur Stadion (53.205278 / 5.814722, 10,500), which the club left in 2024 and which was demolished in late 2025 (its English article: 'Since 2024, the club started to play their home matches in the Kooi Stadion. The stadion was demolished in late 2025'), so the map drew Cambuur at a ground that no longer exists. The club's English article: 'Since August 2024, they have played their home games at the 15,000-seat Kooi Stadion, a purpose-built stadium that replaced Cambuur Stadion'; Dutch Wikipedia: opened 18 August 2024, 15.000 places, 14.504 seated. The 2026-27 Eredivisie stadiums table and StadiumDB (Kooi Stadion, Leeuwarden) both say 15,000, and the ground's own Wikidata item Q122459692 says 15,000 with Cambuur as occupant. Position is that item's own P625; OpenStreetMap's Kooi Stadion is 10 m from it and was 3,134 m from the old pin, which is how OpenStreetMap's capacity check found no stadium near the old pin. Not taken: 10,500, the old ground's capacity. Wikidata's P115 on the club still names the old ground; empty these cells to go back
